info.title: ARC public API
info.summary: Free, no-login API for the ARC open agentic commerce benchmark: check a store, validate UCP, read the Index, leaderboard, protocol matrix and dataset, and contribute stores and runs.
info.description: Any agent can ask whether a brand gets chosen and whether agents can buy. The answer has two lanes: buy.agent_catalog is a live HTTP check of Shopify catalog tools and a valid UCP profile, and buy.browser is the browser cart. The catalog check is not a browser session and not any third-party agent product, and it does not change the score; browser cart results come from ARC browser shoppers A–E. agents_can_buy is true when either lane can finish. What Grok tells shoppers is a real model call via API, checked against the store's pages, not the consumer Grok app. Rivals are omitted when that read does not exist. ARC is not affiliated with Meta, Spear Street Technology, SpaceXAI, OpenAI, or the OpenClaw Foundation. A missing score is not a zero.

get.summary: Latest saved product data from the page’s structured data
get.description: Free DB read. Includes public Google checkout readiness from saved evidence; not Google approval. Merchant Center feed eligibility cannot be checked from outside. No outbound store request. JSON-LD from server HTML only. Null means unmeasured.

200.description: Saved productData, googleReadiness, policies, checkedAt, productUrl and honesty note

get.summary: Free agent facts for any store (Jev typed decisions)
get.description: No login. Returns stored TypeSafe Jev facts from HTTP scrapes. Not a browser session and not any third-party agent product. download=1 returns a JSON attachment.

200.description: Agent facts array with confidences, hashes, and honesty note.

get.summary: Find stores where an AI agent can reach checkout for running shoes or another need
get.description: No login. Reads real HTTP checkout-positive results within seven days. Category matching, not inventory search. 50 reads/network/day and 5,000/site/day, shared with checkout reads. No purchase completed or checkout URLs stored.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug or shopper words, such as running shoes.

200.description: Stores with name, host, category, verdict, checkedAt and arcUrl; total matches, categories, note and directoryUrl. No checkout links.

400.description: Invalid parameters or no matching category.

get.summary: Can an AI agent buy from this store or reach checkout?
get.description: Free real HTTP check of any public homepage or product URL. No login. Cached per host for 24 hours; 50 requests and 10 fresh checks per network per UTC day, 500 fresh checks site-wide. Returns checkoutWebmcp (Shopify-only status, nullable detected, tools, reason; buyer approval required) separately from the storefront webmcp boolean. Never stores a checkout link or changes a score.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public HTTP(S) homepage or product URL.

200.description: Catalog and product facts, checkout link boolean, UCP profile, block status, fix, checkedAt, cached, resultUrl. No checkout URL.

429.description: Daily capacity reached or host check in progress.

get.summary: Validate a store's UCP profile against the published UCP schema
get.description: Fetches https://<host>/.well-known/ucp (no redirects followed, 6 s timeout) and validates it against the published UCP 2026-08-25 JSON Schema (https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/schemas/) and spec rules: authority binding, https endpoints, orphaned extensions, and hosting headers. Returns errors, warnings and info, each with a JSON path and spec link. Not certification. 300 validations per network per day.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Store host, homepage or profile URL, e.g. allbirds.com.

200.description: Report: valid, schema, declaredVersion, counts, errors, warnings, info, summary, http checks, profile, schemaSource and note.

429.description: Rate limited for this network. Try again later.

post.summary: Validate pasted UCP profile JSON, or a URL
post.description: Send {"profile": {...}} to validate JSON without fetching anything, or {"url": "allbirds.com"}.

200.description: Validation report.

429.description: Rate limited for this network. Try again later.

get.summary: Agent commerce adoption counts by category and platform
get.description: Counts and rates from ARC's saved HTTP checks: valid UCP profiles, agent catalogs, storefront WebMCP, Checkout WebMCP (Shopify measured denominator; unknown and not checked separate), checkout links. A curated sample, not all e-commerce.

200.description: now, categories, byPlatform, platformCoverage, series, changes, methodology, generatedAt, available.

get.summary: Protocol Matrix: UCP, ACP, PAP, WebMCP, MCP and payments, stage by stage
get.description: How many checked stores declare, validate, answer and transact on each protocol, with evidence labels (Measured, Inferred, Not measured). Saved checks only. CC-BY-4.0.

200.description: rows, storesChecked, indexStoresChecked, asOf, methodology, license, cite, available and protocols.

get.description: Cart success over the fixed ARC-100 v1 test set (100 real stores, stopped before payment) for ARC browser shoppers A–E, the UCP path and the storefront MCP path, with n, dates, evidence labels and Wilson 95% intervals, plus unverified outside submissions.

parameters.name: stores
parameters.description: 1 to include the per-store result grid.

200.description: Leaderboard JSON, or CSV with format=csv.

get.summary: Submission format, schema URL and a full example body

200.description: method, spec, schema, example and the MCP tool name.

post.description: Format arc-leaderboard-submission/v1 (see /leaderboard/spec and /data/arc-100/v1/submission.schema.json). Runs must stop before payment. Listed as unverified until ARC re-runs a sample. 5 per network per day; 200 KB max.

200.description: Duplicate of an earlier run; the existing id is returned.

201.description: Saved: ok, id, status, n, cart_successes.

429.description: Rate limited for this network. Try again later.

post.summary: Add stores to ARC's free open directory
post.description: One store as url, or up to 50 as hosts. Each host is validated (live HTTPS, not parked, not redirecting to another brand). Accepted stores are queued for ARC's HTTP checks and join the CC-BY dataset with source=submitted. Rate limited per caller.

200.description: results per host with accepted, already_listed, rejected and limited counts.

429.description: Rate limited for this network. Try again later.

get.summary: A store's public card: saved checks, brand claim and links
get.description: Saved data only; no outbound fetch. Brand statements come from the brand and are not measured by ARC. The MCP store_card tool returns a subset with badge and claim URLs.

200.description: host, slug, brandName, brand_claim, rails and links.

parameters.description: Index category or shopper words, for example footwear or running shoes.

post.summary: Read the Index or check checkout via MCP
post.description: JSON body with url, brand, category, or q. A JSON-RPC 2.0 body speaks MCP on this same URL: initialize, tools/list and tools/call. Tools: ask_arc, can_agent_checkout, find_agent_ready_stores, agent_commerce_adoption, product_data_check, google_checkout_readiness, get_agent_facts, list_category_agent_facts, dataset_info, protocol_matrix, agent_leaderboard, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, store_card, validate_ucp_profile. Docs per tool: https://www.arcreport.ai/developers/mcp. JSON checkout check: GET /api/agent-checkout?url=. No login. This does not start a scan.

200.description: Index answer or a JSON-RPC result.

429.description: Too many Index reads from this network.

503.description: Index reads are paused for a moment.
